statement: In triangle $ABC$, $O$ is the circumcenter, $D$ the midpoint of $AB$, and $E$ the centroid of triangle $ACD$. Show that $CD \perp OE$ if and only if $AB = AC$.

Let $a, b, c, d \in [-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}]$ with $\sin a + \sin b + \sin c + \sin d = 1$ and $\cos 2a + \cos 2b + \cos 2c + \cos 2d \geq \frac{10}{3}$. Prove that $a, b, c, d \in [0, \frac{\pi}{6}]$.

Let $S$ be the set of all positive integers of the form $19a + 85b$ where $a, b$ are positive integers. On the real axis, color points of $S$ red and all other integers green. Does there exist a point $A$ on the real axis such that any two integers symmetric with respect to $A$ necessarily have distinct colors?

There are $1985$ participants at an international meeting. In any group of three participants, at least two speak the same language. Each participant speaks at most five languages. Prove that at least $200$ participants speak the same language.
